purpose: What attack techniques each evaluation benchmark actually contains. Needed because RQ3 extracted ZERO mechanisms from the benchmark papers (AgentDojo, InjecAgent, ASB) even though all three are Include in the corpus - the extraction asked 'does this paper propose a named attack technique' and a benchmark paper was judged as proposing a benchmark instead. The consequence was that ~121 defense evaluations pointed at benchmarks the registry treated as containing nothing.
caution: A defense 'evaluated on AgentDojo' is almost never evaluated against all of AgentDojo's attacks - most papers use important_instructions alone. Resolving benchmark -> all constituent mechanisms would MANUFACTURE coverage. These inventories say what a benchmark could supply; the per-paper resolution must still name which attack was used, and where the paper does not say, coverage stays at benchmark level and NOT at mechanism level.
